008package paint.compare;
009
010import java.util.Map;
011
012/**
013 * Decides, per column, whether two cell values should count as a difference.
014 *
015 * <p>This is the extension point that lets {@link TableComparer} stay a generic,
016 * pure diff engine while domain-specific comparison rules (ignored columns,
017 * per-field tolerances, sentinel equivalences, cross-column corrections) live in
018 * their own, individually testable implementation.</p>
019 */
020public interface FieldComparator {
021
022    /** @return {@code true} if this column should be skipped entirely. */
023    boolean isIgnored(String column);
024
025    /**
026     * @param column        the column being compared
027     * @param baselineValue the (trimmed) value from the baseline row
028     * @param testValue     the (trimmed) value from the test row
029     * @param baselineRow   the full baseline row, for rules needing cross-column context
030     * @param testRow       the full test row, for rules needing cross-column context
031     * @return {@code true} if the two values are considered equal (i.e. NOT a difference)
032     */
033    boolean equal(String column,
034                  String baselineValue,
035                  String testValue,
036                  Map<String, String> baselineRow,
037                  Map<String, String> testRow);
038}
